# Woodex Interior

> Lahore-based design-build studio: architecture, interior design, construction fit-outs, furniture and joinery (Woodex Furniture™), and 3D visualization. One partner from drawing to delivery — requirement, drawings, 3D approval, fixed BOQ, build, handover.

Contact: LG 90 Link Road, Model Town, Lahore, Pakistan · studio@woodex.interior · WhatsApp +92 322 4000768 · Call +92 336 2259477 · Mon–Sun 10:00–20:30
Proof: 200–500 projects · 10+ years founder-led · ISO 9001-grade process · only named client: Wellstar Pharmacy, Cosmetics & Mini Hospital, DHA Lahore
